findingDetails.title: The 009 opening counts the name-and-description list among what is worth taking, but no lift row takes it and the differences table defers it
findingDetails.scopeProof: research.md:286 names the list; the 009 lift table research.md:290-294 holds no list row; research.md:300 defers it as a weighed alternative; B/009-skills/spec.md:161-162 and :175 are the plan lines the deferral protects
findingDetails.case: A builder reads the 009 opening, sees the name-and-description list named as one of two parts worth taking, and looks for the lift row that says how to take it. There is none. If the builder implements the list tier from the opening sentence instead, it lands without the digest pin the differences row requires, which is the governance hole that row exists to prevent.
findingDetails.claim: research.md:286 names the name-and-description list as one of two parts of skills.js worth taking, but the 009 lift table (research.md:290-294) has no row for it and research.md:300 defers it as a weighed alternative for a later phase.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the whole 009 section for a fourth lift row or a sentence that reconciles the opening with the deferral. There is none: the lift table closes after row 3 and the differences row 1 is the only place the list tier appears. Checked whether "worth taking" could mean "worth taking later", which would reconcile them; the sentence names the two parts as what the section takes, and the section takes one.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The opening may be summarising the phase whole evidence rather than its lift table, in which case the list tier is worth taking as a weighed alternative. That reading is available but not stated, and the differences row own wording ("a later phase can add it") is what a builder needs to see before the opening sentence.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to no finding if the 009 opening is read as a summary of the phase evidence rather than of its lift table, or if a lift row for the list tier is added.

results.notes: Every sampled row in 009-014 and section 5 re-read against the line or range it cites; the citations resolve and say what the row claims. The one exception is the summary sentence at research.md:286, recorded as V2-R9-P2-001.
The packet has no checklist.md at Level 1, so there is no checklist to trace against.

noveltyJustification: One new P2 and nothing else this iteration, so the ratio is 1.0 on the per-iteration denominator iterations 1-8 used. Against the 7 accumulated severity-weighted points from iterations 1-8 the same finding is 0.125. The finding is a new instance of the summary-versus-table class first recorded as V2-R5-P2-001, not a refinement of it: it sits in a different phase section and names a different table. Every other row in 009-014 and section 5 was re-read against its cited lines and held, so the ratio reflects a genuinely clean sweep rather than a shallow one.
